# Ciro Code

> Local-first coding agent with a Web workbench. Inference goes only to providers you configure.

Install: npm install -g @ciro-code/code
CLI: ciro (default TUI) · ciro web (workbench)
Workbench: http://127.0.0.1:5280
Health: GET /health
Smoke: ciro web --mock --no-open

Do not install: npm i -g ciro
Prefer package: @ciro-code/code (or @ciro-code/cli)
